Once approved, you'll also be able to add **AGY HUD** directly from **Customizations → Marketplace** in Antigravity Desktop and click the **"Set up the HUD status line in Antigravity CLI"** starter prompt chip to activate both the status line and global `/hud` & `/hud-update` shortcuts. ### Dual-Compatible Slash Commands (`/hud` + `/agy-hud:hud`) `agy-hud` is engineered to work seamlessly as **both** a full Antigravity plugin and short, ergonomic slash commands across **Antigravity CLI (`agy`)** and **Antigravity App**: - **Full Plugin Bundle**: Retains the standard `agy-hud` v1 plugin manifest (Marketplace & `agy plugin install` compatible), exposing `/agy-hud:hud` and `/agy-hud:hud-update`. - **Conflict-Safe Unprefixed Shortcuts**: Whenever `install.sh`, `agy-hud install`, or `agy-hud update` runs, it also deploys managed standalone copies to `~/.gemini/config/skills/hud` and `~/.gemini/config/skills/hud-update` (tagged with `.agy-hud-managed.json`), enabling `/hud` and `/hud-update` everywhere in both `agy` CLI and Antigravity App. - **Zero Overwrite Guarantee**: Before deploying each shortcut, `agy-hud` inspects existing paths/symlinks and reads `~/.gemini/config/skills.json` strictly read-only. `/agy-hud:hud-update`. - **Immediate vs. One-Time Activation**: - **One-line `install.sh` users** get `/hud` and `/hud-update` (alongside `/agy-hud:hud` and `/agy-hud:hud-update`) immediately. - **`agy plugin install` / Marketplace users** run `/agy-hud:hud` (or click the starter prompt chip / ask in natural language) once to activate; after that, `/hud` and `/hud-update` work everywhere too. Architecture & Security (`THE LINE`) `agy-hud` enforces capability isolation at compile time across a two-crate Rust workspace (continuously verified by [`arch_guard.rs`](crates/hud-core/tests/arch_guard.rs)). See [**ARCHITECTURE.md**](ARCHITECTURE.md) for full details: ```text agy-hud/ ├── crates/ │ ├── hud-core/ # Pure deterministic logic & layout crate (#![forbid(unsafe_code)], ZERO I/O) │ └── hud-cli/ # Thin capability shell: bounded file seeks, hardened VCS probes, atomic cache I/O ├── skills/ # Antigravity slash-command skills (/hud & /agy-hud:hud, /hud-update & /agy-hud:hud-update) ├── scripts/ # POSIX platform router & SHA-256 Marketplace binary sync tooling └── plugin.json # Strict Antigravity v1 plugin manifest ``` 1. **Zero-I/O Pure Core (`hud-core`)**: Depends **only** on `serde` and `serde_json` (11 total transitive crates) and is statically forbidden from referencing `std::fs`, `std::process`, `std::net`, `std::env`, or `std::os`. 2. **Command-Injection-Safe VCS Probes (`hud-cli`)**: - **Git**: Enforces `-c protocol.allow=never`, `-c core.fsmonitor=false`, `--no-optional-locks`, `GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH=1`, and dynamically parses `.git/config` in memory to neutralize repo-local `[filter ""]` `clean`/`smudge`/`process` drivers before invoking `git`. - **Jujutsu (`jj`) & Mercurial (`hg`)**: Enforces `--ignore-working-copy --at-operation=@ --no-pager` and `HGPLAIN=1 --config extensions.fsmonitor=!` under a strict `1200 ms` timeout. 3. **Terminal Escape Firewall (`terminal_filter`)**: Every line written to `stdout` is scrubbed against OSC 52 clipboard exfiltration, window title hijacking, cursor-movement CSI escapes, and Unicode Bidi Trojans (`U+202A..U+202E`, `U+2066..U+2069`), allowing only SGR styling and local `file://` OSC 8 links. --- ## 🧪 Development & Verification ```bash cargo fmt --all -- --check # Verify Rustfmt formatting cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings # Enforce zero Clippy warnings cargo test --workspace # Run unit, CLI e2e, Git filter canary & arch_guard suites cargo build --release # Build stripped LTO native binary agy plugin validate --strict . # Validate Antigravity plugin manifest & skills ``` --- ## 📄 License Distributed under the [**MIT License**](LICENSE). KB`，无任何虚拟机冷启动开销；`std::thread::scope` 多线程并行采集，`transcript.jsonl` 支持增量字节偏移游标（`transcript-cursors/.json`），超长多 MB 会话依然完整保留早期激活的技能、MCP 与工具累计计数。 - **📐 首轮会话 DB 上限、诚实冷启动与配额 `0%` 容错**：纯 Rust 严格只读解析当前会话 SQLite B-Tree 与已提交 `-wal` 页（零 C/SQLite 依赖，不创建 `-shm` 锁文件），在首轮对话即获取真实模型压缩上限；未确认 `>= 900k` 大窗口时如实展示中性 `/?` 而不盲猜 `256k`；通过双阈值（下降 `> 5k` 且 `>= 25%`）精确识别隐式压缩并免疫影子模型与撤回/回退；同时还原 Proto3 省略的 `0%` 耗尽配额桶并过滤哨兵时间戳（`<= 2000-01-01`）。 - **🎯 混合毫秒级 `~tok/s` 测速与配额增速预警（`▲`）**：精确剥离 `thinking`/Prefill 首字延迟（`TTFT`）与工具等待时间，并受 `display.showSpeed` 控制展示速度分档图标（`🐢` `<50`、`🛵` `50–99`、`🚗` `100–149`、`🚅` `150–199`、`✈️` `200–249`、`🚀` `250–299`、`🛰️` `300–399`、`🛸` `400–499`、`👽` `500+`；`display.glyphMode=ascii` 时隐藏）与会话 `(min~max)` 速率区间（由已完成步骤或原生 `stdin` 速率累积、跨模型切换保留、出现两个不同取整速率后展示）；同时 `display.quotaPace` 根据时间窗口剩余比例智能预测配额耗尽速度（提前亮起琥珀/红色 `▲`），`display.showDailyCost` / `showWeeklyCost` 跨会话幂等汇总今日/本周开销。 - **🎨 完整字素簇宽度引擎与可组合布局**：零硬编码黑白灰前景色，深浅色主题通吃；纯 Rust 完整支持 Unicode Extended Grapheme Clusters（ZWJ 组合 Emoji、肤色修饰符、国旗双区域指示符、CJK 双列对齐），支持 `display.mergeGroups` 多行自由合并（窄屏自动堆叠并对齐中文进度条起始列）与 `display.rightAlign` 右对齐。 - **🌿 纵深安全加固的 `git` / `jj` / `hg` 探针**：内置 Windows `CreateProcessW` 工作目录可执行劫持防御、作用域感知的 Git `[include]` 过滤器精准拆弹（保留全局 `git-lfs`，仅清空不可信仓库过滤器，异常过滤器名自动降级至零子进程 `.git/HEAD`）、GitHub 分支点击跳转与 `↑N` 未推送阈值变色提醒。 - **🔄 内置 SHA-256 校验自更新**：每 6 小时后台静默检查新版本并在顶栏温和提示（`↑ vX.Y.Z · /hud-update`，未安装或存在冲突时自动回退显示 `/agy-hud:hud-update`），一键校验升级二进制、插件与托管快捷技能，并完整保留 `--stack` 与个性化配置。 - **🌏 原生多语言界面**：根据系统语言自动选择，亦可手动切换英文（`en`）、简体中文（`zh-Hans`）与日语（`ja`）。 --- ## 📦 安装指南 ### 环境要求 - **Antigravity CLI (`agy`)** `v1.4.5+`（已完整对齐 `v1.5.4`–`v1.5.13` 最新内部接口、`/title`、`/resume `、`GEMINI_API_KEY` 配额隐藏与 `auto_edit` 模式） - **零 Rust / Node.js / npm 依赖**（使用一键脚本、GitHub 插件或预编译包安装时无需编译环境；仅从源码构建时需 `rustc 1.85+`） > **Marketplace 上架状态**：已提交至 Antigravity Marketplace 官方审核队列，审核通过后即可在 Antigravity 桌面端 **Customizations → Marketplace** 中搜索 **AGY HUD** 一键添加，并点击 **"Set up the HUD status line in Antigravity CLI"** 快捷引导胶囊一键启用状态栏与全局 `/hud`、`/hud-update` 快捷技能。 ### 双兼顾斜杠命令设计（`/hud` + `/agy-hud:hud`） `agy-hud` 同时兼顾 **Antigravity 官方插件规范** 与 **无前缀短斜杠命令体验**，并原生覆盖 **Antigravity CLI (`agy`) 与 Antigravity App**： - **完整保留插件形态**：保留标准 `agy-hud` v1 插件结构（完整兼容 Marketplace 与 `agy plugin install`），原生提供 `/agy-hud:hud` 与 `/agy-hud:hud-update`。 - **冲突安全的无前缀快捷技能**：在执行 `install.sh`、`agy-hud install` 或 `agy-hud update` 时，`agy-hud` 会向 `~/.gemini/config/skills/hud` 与 `~/.gemini/config/skills/hud-update` 部署带 `.agy-hud-managed.json` 归属标记的独立托管技能，使无前缀 `/hud` 与 `/hud-update` 在 **Antigravity CLI 与 Antigravity App** 中均可直接调用。 - **零覆盖安全保障**：写入前会先检查目标目录与软链接，并以**严格只读**方式检查 `~/.gemini/config/skills.json`。若发现你已自定义非 `agy-hud` 的 `/hud` 或 `/hud-update` 技能（或对应的 `skills.json` 条目），`agy-hud` 绝不覆盖且绝不修改 `skills.json`，自动保留原有命令并继续使用 `/agy-hud:hud` 与 `/agy-hud:hud-update`。 - **开箱即用 vs. 一次激活**： - **方式一（一行脚本 `install.sh`）用户**：安装完成后立即可用 `/hud` 与 `/hud-update`（同时兼容 `/agy-hud:hud` 与 `/agy-hud:hud-update`）。 - **`agy plugin install` / Marketplace 用户**：先运行一次 `/agy-hud:hud`（或点击快捷引导胶囊 / 用自然语言触发）完成激活后，`/hud` 与 `/hud-update` 同样会在 CLI 与桌面端全局生效。 ### 方式一：一行脚本 SHA-256 校验安装（推荐，macOS & Linux） 自动识别平台架构（`darwin-arm64`、`darwin-x64`、`linux-x64`、`linux-arm64`），下载发行包并比对 `SHA256SUMS` 校验和，注册 `agy-hud` 插件（`/agy-hud:hud` 与 `/agy-hud:hud-update`），向 `~/.gemini/config/skills/` 部署冲突安全的托管快捷技能（`/hud` 与 `/hud-update`），部署原生二进制至 `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/agy-hud/bin/agy-hud` 并原子更新 `settings.json`： ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/maxlee/agy-hud/main/install.sh | sh ``` Architecture & Security (`THE LINE`) `agy-hud` enforces capability isolation at compile time across a two-crate Rust workspace (continuously verified by [`arch_guard.rs`](crates/hud-core/tests/arch_guard.rs)). See [**ARCHITECTURE.md**](ARCHITECTURE.md) for full details: ```text agy-hud/ ├── crates/ │ ├── hud-core/ # Pure deterministic logic & layout crate (#![forbid(unsafe_code)], ZERO I/O) │ └── hud-cli/ # Thin capability shell: bounded file seeks, hardened VCS probes, atomic cache I/O ├── skills/ # Antigravity slash-command skills (/hud & /agy-hud:hud, /hud-update & /agy-hud:hud-update) ├── scripts/ # POSIX platform router & SHA-256 Marketplace binary sync tooling └── plugin.json # Strict Antigravity v1 plugin manifest ``` 1. **Zero-I/O Pure Core (`hud-core`)**: Depends **only** on `serde` and `serde_json` (11 total transitive crates) and is statically forbidden from referencing `std::fs`, `std::process`, `std::net`, `std::env`, or `std::os`. 2. **Command-Injection-Safe VCS Probes (`hud-cli`)**: - **Git**: Enforces `-c protocol.allow=never`, `-c core.fsmonitor=false`, `--no-optional-locks`, `GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH=1`, and dynamically parses `.git/config` in memory to neutralize repo-local `[filter ""]` `clean`/`smudge`/`process` drivers before invoking `git`. - **Jujutsu (`jj`) & Mercurial (`hg`)**: Enforces `--ignore-working-copy --at-operation=@ --no-pager` and `HGPLAIN=1 --config extensions.fsmonitor=!` under a strict `1200 ms` timeout. 3. **Terminal Escape Firewall (`terminal_filter`)**: Every line written to `stdout` is scrubbed against OSC 52 clipboard exfiltration, window title hijacking, cursor-movement CSI escapes, and Unicode Bidi Trojans (`U+202A..U+202E`, `U+2066..U+2069`), allowing only SGR styling and local `file://` OSC 8 links. --- ## 🧪 Development & Verification ```bash cargo fmt --all -- --check # Verify Rustfmt formatting cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings # Enforce zero Clippy warnings cargo test --workspace # Run unit, CLI e2e, Git filter canary & arch_guard suites cargo build --release # Build stripped LTO native binary agy plugin validate --strict . # Validate Antigravity plugin manifest & skills ``` --- ## 📄 License Distributed under the [**MIT License**](LICENSE).
